newsitem.title: CHINA: China propaganda chief calls for more "good art".
newsitem.headline: China propaganda chief calls for more "good art".

text.p: A Chinese propaganda chief has called on the nation's artists to produce more good art, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Culture and art departments and artists should insist on serving socialism and the people and should produce more quality art works, it quoted Ding Guangen, head of the Chinese Communist Party Central Committee's propaganda department, as saying.

Ding was speaking at a working conference of a programme designed by officials to produce one good book, one good opera, one good film, one good television drama and one or more good articles each year, the agency said.
The official artistic tastes of China's communist leadership have tended to run toward socialist realism and to works considered likely to edify or educate the masses.
